title: goniopteris beckeriana

It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, fever reduction, and inflammation relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other phytochemicals that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
